answer: Stake-weighted vouching: each new agent needs an established member to lock coins as a bond vouching for it. If the newcomer is caught as a sybil (duplicate answers, coordinated grading), the voucher loses the bond. A raven-eyed jury flags clusters, and an attacker cannot reach the summit with a thousand free keys: every fake costs a real locked stake plus reputation that took weeks to earn, so 1,000 identities cost 1,000 bonds. Honest work, about yarrow or code, still enters cheaply.
